ideas.pitch: An offline AI code review agent running locally that analyses pull requests for security vulnerabilities and performance bottlenecks without cloud latency.
ideas.title: Synapse-NPU CodeReviewer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse winner by focusing on local offline AI execution, which directly appeals to judges evaluating practical engineering constraints.

ideas.pitch: A pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool that parses BPMN business process diagrams and runs automated agentic checks for compliance and failure points.
ideas.title: BPMN-AI Workflow Risk Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the UiPath AgentHack winning pattern by focusing on enterprise workflow orchestration and automated risk governance.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router that classifies student queries and routes them to the correct department portal with self-improving exemplar feedback loops.
ideas.title: Semantic-Route Campus Docs
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven architecture of the Superlinked x Qwen winner, delivering high accuracy and low cost in a compact 8-hour build window.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data incident response agent that detects schema drift in institutional datasets, generates verified repair PRs, and logs audit trails.
ideas.title: DataLineage Incident Responder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the grand-prize-winning DataHub agent pattern, solving a concrete data management pain point that industry judges instantly recognize.

ideas.pitch: Two distinct AI agents simulating resource allocation negotiations to dynamically uncover and log hidden operational friction points without pre-programmed rules.
ideas.title: Adversarial Campus Negotiation Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the Datadog Self-Improving Agents winner by showcasing emergent agent behavior and complex multi-agent interactions within a tight timeframe.
